name: Minicraft Vita
long_description:
This is a port of the Ludum Dare #22 entry by Notch called Minicraft.

Minicraft is a 2D top-down sandbox game where your final goal is to "kill the only other sentient being in the world, making sure youâ€™ll be alone forever" as stated personally by Notch when he first released this game.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
